en.meta.desc.home: Open-source projects by Zhong Shanshan: an Android Markdown editor, a runtime above the LLM, a local Ollama coding assistant, an OCR MCP server, a JDK switcher for Windows, and seven essays.
en.hint.gesture: Drag · Scroll to zoom · Double-click to reset
en.home.title: I build the tools, and I write down the hard parts
en.home.lede: Seven open-source projects: Mdeditor, a Markdown editor for Android; Intent OS, a deterministic runtime above the LLM; a local Ollama coding assistant for the terminal; a Claude Code hook that locks down MiniMax and nothing else; an OCR MCP server; a pure-batch JDK switcher for Windows; and this site. Seven essays run along one thread: what decides the outcome is never the model itself, but the layer you put underneath it.
